title: Voltaback — reimbursing employees for charging company EVs at home, from car and meter data
money_note: EUR 2.8M raised from Serena and business angels, announced 2026-10-01 (tech.eu, the url); stated in EUR, no FX.
summary: French startup Voltaback reconstructs each home-charging session of a company electric car from connected-vehicle data, electricity bills and meters, prices it on the employee's own tariff and issues a reimbursement receipt accepted by the French social-security collector, without extra hardware. It raised EUR 2.8M in October 2026 and says 20% of CAC 40 companies, including Veolia and Equans, use it.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: a Czech employer that gives staff a company EV has the same problem: separate business from private electricity at the employee's home and pay it back in a form the tax office accepts. Czech law already prices it (the MPSV úhradová vyhláška reference electricity price), and fDrive (2025-11-25, saved cz-fdrive-futurego.html) reports that from January 2026 the meter used for this must be officially verified every four years, and that screenshots or manual logs no longer suffice for larger fleets. URGENCY 0 on the signal: the source names no dated instrument (the Czech meter rule is local context, not this record's score). SCALE 2 (companies with EV fleets). RECURRENCE 2 (monthly reimbursement). MATURITY (abroad): founding year not stated in the source, so the years limb is not receipted; the traction limb is (named customers Veolia, Equans, BNP Paribas, Sodexo; 20% of CAC 40) - recorded as early on the mechanical test. CZ CHECK, queries run 2026-10-05: (1) 'proplácení nabíjení služebního elektromobilu doma zaměstnanec vyúčtování'; (2) 'domácí nabíjení firemního elektromobilu wallbox měření a refundace zaměstnanci služba pro firmy'; (3) 'aplikace evidence nabíjení služebních elektromobilů data z auta náhrada za elektřinu zaměstnanci fleet software'. FOUND: ČEZ, a. s. (IČO 45274649) sells the futurego smart charging cable with a built-in billing meter, eSIM backend and employer dashboard used exactly to reimburse home charging monthly (fDrive 2025-11-25 and e-flotila 2024-10-03, both saved) - competes: direct; maturity: early ON THE TEST, because e-flotila dates the first-generation cable to the year before October 2024 ('loni uvedený'), so three years of selling THIS product is not receipted, and no customer count was found. Chargee eMobility, a.s. (IČO 03947092, since 2015) runs the Chargee Fleet app with charging reports for company and pool cars - competes: adjacent (charging network/app; home-charging reimbursement not shown). MyBox s.r.o. (IČO 07750471, since 2019) sells wallboxes with a cloud for fleet managers - competes: adjacent (hardware). NOT FOUND: a Czech seller of the hardware-free method (reconstructing home sessions from car telematics and meter data). That is a sub-niche observation. VERDICT: contested - one direct Czech seller (ČEZ futurego), not established on the test.
